title: 第一卷 第6章 峰主归来第一卷 第11章 招聘现场
slug: 百倍返还我家孽徒全是女帝转世
content_zh:
洞府之内，柳雨姝服下极品洗髓疗伤丹，静静盘坐修炼。
丹药有一股淡淡的药香，入口化作一股温和的药力，游走全身经脉。
她原本新旧伤遍布的肉身，在疗伤丹的滋养下迅速修复，体表的污垢汗液不断排出。
那枚贴身佩戴的下品灵石，也在源源不断散发出微弱的灵气，皆被她的丹田所吸收。
就在这时，她体内沉寂许久的特殊体质，悄然被激活！
一丝冰凉圣洁的太阴灵气，自她丹田深处缓缓苏醒，并且在不断扩大。
柳雨姝身躯微震，满脸震撼。
她能清晰感觉到，自己的修行速度暴涨十倍不止，丹田正在疯狂地吸收附近的天地灵气！
她拳头攥得很紧，额头不断冒出冷汗。
曾经一夜暴跌、寸步难行的锻体三层修为壁垒，此刻仿佛触手可破！
她难以置信地望向洞外师尊打坐的方向，心中愈发敬畏。
师父这随手赠予的丹药，效果竟然如此逆天，不仅能治愈伤势，还能唤醒体质！
这一刻，林枫在她心中的神秘感，又上了一个档次。
……
与此同时，青云宫内外，各处山峰外门驻地，关于林枫的议论，悄然蔓延开来。
“你们听说了吗？那个整日闭门不出的小竹峰峰主，今日居然下山了！”
“下山又如何？一个废人罢了！当年何等惊艳，三十岁逼近化神，如今还不是终生困死筑基境？”
“听说他在清溪镇为了一个凡人小乞丐，当众出手打伤市井凡人，丢尽了咱们青云宫的脸面！”
“真是越活越回去了！昔日的天之骄子，如今自甘堕落，净掺和凡间之事！”
“如今掌教闭关不出，林枫峰主沦为废人，咱们青云宫底蕴大损，他不去培养有潜力的弟子，还有心思胡闹！”

“哪是他不收弟子，筑基层巅峰的修为，不过是一个中级弟子的实力罢了，谁会愿意拜一个筑基层的老师。”
“依我看，小竹峰早已名存实亡，再过不久，宗门大概率会撤销小竹峰峰主席位，将他彻底边缘化！”
嘲讽的话语，不断在洒扫的外门弟子口中出现。
若是换做从前摆烂的林枫，对此只会置若罔闻。
但此刻，根基已经开始修复的林枫，听到这些话语，眸底却燃起了抗争的光芒。
他攥紧拳头。
嘲讽他、落井下石之人，很快就会亲眼见证，属于他的归来！
……
夜深人静，洞府内的柳雨姝结束修炼，眉头微蹙。
早上服用了师父给她的极品洗髓疗伤丹后，她就一直在修炼，到了傍晚修为已经突破锻体境五层。
她想将这个好消息告诉师父，师父却一日未归，只能先作罢了。
她思考苏家被灭门的那一夜。
当年苏家乃是大楚四大家族之一，她们家世代修善，从未招惹魔道强敌，也没有世仇。
可一夜之间，满门上下数百口人尽数被屠杀，无一幸免。
外界传言，是魔道修士随机屠戮正道家族。
可她今日体质觉醒，便隐隐察觉到一丝不对劲。
那场灭门浩劫针对性极强，那一夜只有她们苏家被杀了，且过后很长一段时间再没有魔道屠杀正道家族的事迹。
更像是有人刻意想抹杀身负太阴之体的修仙者，刻意斩草除根！
content_en:
Inside the cave, Liu Yushu took the best marrow-cleansing and healing elixir and quietly sat cross-legged to practice.
The elixir has a faint medicinal fragrance, and when you enter it, it transforms into a mild medicinal power that travels through the meridians of the body.
Her body, which was originally covered with old and new wounds, was quickly repaired under the nourishment of the healing pill, and the dirt and sweat on the body surface were continuously discharged.
The low-grade spiritual stone worn close to her body was also continuously emitting weak spiritual energy, which was absorbed by her Dantian.
At this moment, the special physique in her body that had been dormant for a long time was quietly activated!
A trace of cold and holy Taiyin spiritual energy slowly awakened from the depths of her Dantian and continued to expand.
Liu Yushu's body trembled slightly, her face full of shock.
She could clearly feel that her cultivation speed had increased by more than ten times, and her Dantian was frantically absorbing the nearby spiritual energy of heaven and earth!
She clenched her fists tightly, and cold sweat broke out on her forehead.
The three-layer cultivation barrier that once plummeted overnight and was difficult to move forward now seems to be within reach!
She looked in disbelief at the direction where Master was meditating outside the cave, feeling more and more in awe.
The elixir that Master gave me so casually has such incredible effects. It can not only heal injuries, but also awaken the body!
At this moment, Lin Feng's sense of mystery in her heart reached another level.
…
At the same time, discussions about Lin Feng quietly spread inside and outside Qingyun Palace and at the outer gates of various mountain peaks.
"Have you heard? The master of Xiaozhu Peak, who has been staying shut all day, actually came down the mountain today!"
"So what if I go down the mountain? I'm just a useless person! How amazing I was back then. I'm on the verge of becoming a god at the age of thirty, but now I'm not stuck in the foundation-building realm for the rest of my life?"
"I heard that for a mortal beggar in Qingxi Town, he publicly injured a mortal and brought shame on our Qingyun Palace!"
"It's true that the more I live, the more I go back! The former proud man of heaven has now fallen into obscurity and is meddling in the affairs of the world!"
"Now that the headmaster cannot come out of seclusion, Peak Master Lin Feng has become a useless person, and the foundation of our Qingyun Palace has been greatly damaged. He does not cultivate potential disciples, and he is still thinking nonsense!"
"It's because he doesn't accept disciples. The cultivation level at the top of the basic level is just the strength of an intermediate disciple. Who would want to be a teacher at the basic level?"
"In my opinion, Xiaozhufeng has long existed in name only. In the near future, the sect will most likely revoke Xiaozhufeng's position as chairman and completely marginalize him!"
Ridiculing words kept appearing in the mouths of Sasu's outer disciples.
If it were Lin Feng who had been so bad in the past, he would just turn a deaf ear to this.
But at this moment, Lin Feng, whose foundation had begun to repair, heard these words, and the light of struggle ignited in his eyes.
He clenched his fists.
Those who ridicule him and add insult to injury will soon witness with their own eyes his return!
…
In the dead of night, Liu Yushu finished her practice in the cave and frowned slightly.
After taking the top-quality marrow-cleansing and healing elixir given to her by her master in the morning, she continued to practice. By evening, her cultivation had broken through the fifth level of the physical training realm.
She wanted to tell her master the good news, but he didn't come back all day, so she had to give up first.
She thought about the night when the Su family was exterminated.
Back then, the Su family was one of the four major families in Da Chu. Their family had practiced good deeds for generations and had never provoked any powerful demonic enemies or had any feuds.
But overnight, hundreds of people in the house were massacred, and no one was spared.
There are rumors from the outside that it is the demonic monks who randomly slaughter the righteous families.
But when she woke up today, she faintly noticed something was wrong.
That catastrophe was extremely targeted. Only the Su family was killed that night, and for a long time after that, there was no more demonic massacre of the righteous family.
It's more like someone deliberately wants to obliterate the immortal cultivator who has the body of Taiyin, and deliberately eradicates the roots!
